content_sections.heading: Walk-In Procedure
content_sections.text: Candidates who wish to attend the walk-in interview for KSSSCI Various Posts Recruitment 2026 should follow the steps below. Read the official notification carefully before attending the interview. Candidates must report at the venue as per the reporting time mentioned in the notification. Carry all original documents along with one set of self-attested photocopies such as ID proof, educational certificates, experience certificates (if required), and category certificate (if applicable). Bring the duly filled application form if required in the notification. Verify eligibility criteria before attending the interview. Candidates are advised to reach the venue well in advance to complete registration formalities. Keep extra passport-size photographs for submission if required. Fill the attached application form legibly, make online payment and mention the amount & date on the application form & enclose receipt. Bring filled application form, self-attested photocopies and original documents for verification. Make payment of requisite fee (non-refundable), Rs. 500/- by RTGS/NEFT to the Account No. 37868945001, Name of Account: 'Director, SSCI&II, Academic Account', Name of Bank and Branch: State Bank of India, SGPGIMS, Raebareli Road, Lucknow, IFSC Code: SBIN0007789. Enclose the receipt of payment with the application.

faq.question: Q1. What is the last date to attend the walk-in interview for KSSSCI Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: The walk-in interview for KSSSCI Recruitment 2026 is scheduled for 31-08-2026. Candidates should ensure they report at the venue on this date with all necessary documents.

faq.question: Q2. How many vacancies are available for the Senior Resident post?
faq.answer: There are a total of 19 vacancies for the Senior Resident (Hospital Services) post at Kalyan Singh Super Specialty Cancer Institute.

faq.question: Q3. What is the educational qualification required for the Senior Resident post?
faq.answer: The required educational qualifications include MBBS/BDS/MIHA degree recognized by MCI/DCI, MBBS/BDS, and Matriculation.

faq.question: Q4. What is the age limit for the Senior Resident post?
faq.answer: The maximum age limit for the Senior Resident post is 45 years. Age relaxation is applicable as per UP Government rules/DoPT rules for reserved categories.

faq.question: Q5. What is the salary offered for the Senior Resident post?
faq.answer: The selected candidates will receive a salary of Rs. 67,700/- in the pay matrix Rs. 67,700-2,08,700, Level-11.

faq.question: Q6. What is the application fee for KSSSCI Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: The application fee is Rs. 500/- (Non-refundable) for all categories.

faq.question: Q7. How can candidates apply for this recruitment?
faq.answer: This is a walk-in recruitment. Candidates need to attend the walk-in interview with the filled application form, original documents, and photocopies.

faq.question: Q8. What is the selection process for the Senior Resident post?
faq.answer: The selection process for the Senior Resident post will be based on an Interview.

faq.question: Q9. Where is the Kalyan Singh Super Specialty Cancer Institute located?
faq.answer: Kalyan Singh Super Specialty Cancer Institute is located in Lucknow, Uttar Pradesh, with the pincode 226002.

faq.question: Q10. What is the job type for this recruitment?
faq.answer: The job type for this recruitment is Contractual.
